citations.claim: initial velocity is large downward (-18.08 m/s), creating large velocity error vs waypoint-directed command
controller force at first step exceeds declared fmax limit

counterfactual.change: Reduced kp from 25.84 to 5.0 only; proportional velocity-error force then stays under fmax, so no violation.

explanation: Controller computes proportional force kp*m*(v_desired - v_actual) plus seeded noise but never clamps magnitude to fmax. At step 0 velocity error is ~10 m/s (desired ~(-5.9,-10.2) toward waypoint vs actual (0,-18)), so kp~25.8 demands ~200+ N, exceeding fmax 160.365 at step 1 (208.475 N). Lowering kp removes the violation, confirming missing saturation/clamp.
vision_note: A red circular body sits slightly above and to the right of a green waypoint cross. Between step 0 and step 1 it barely moves, with no visible collision or escape.
